batch: 5 (chs 25-32, oracles against the nations - pride and gloating judged)

units.characteristics: malicious gloating over another's fall; vengeance nursed in the soul
units.gist: the nations (Ammon, Moab, Edom, Philistia) judged for their interiors: 'because you said AHA! over my sanctuary when it was profaned and over the land of Israel when it was laid waste'; 'you have clapped your hands and stamped your feet and REJOICED WITH ALL THE MALICE WITHIN YOUR SOUL'; 'took vengeance with MALICE OF SOUL to destroy in NEVER-ENDING ENMITY' - the heart that gloats over a neighbour's ruin and nurses a perpetual grudge

units.characteristics: self-deifying pride; the fall from perfection through pride in beauty; wisdom corrupted by vanity
units.gist: GEM - Tyre's 'AHA' at Jerusalem's fall (commercial opportunism); the prince of Tyre - 'your heart is PROUD, and you have said, I AM A GOD, I SIT IN THE SEAT OF THE GODS'; 'by your wisdom you made wealth... your heart has become PROUD in your wealth'; 'you are but a MAN, and no god'; the king of Tyre - 'you were the SIGNET OF PERFECTION, full of wisdom, PERFECT IN BEAUTY... BLAMELESS from the day you were created, TILL UNRIGHTEOUSNESS WAS FOUND IN YOU'; 'your heart was PROUD because of your BEAUTY; you CORRUPTED YOUR WISDOM for the sake of your splendour'

units.characteristics: crediting oneself with the gift received; the towering self felled for its pride
units.gist: GEM - Pharaoh 'the great dragon... that says, MY NILE IS MY OWN; I MADE IT for myself' (crediting oneself with what one only received); the towering CEDAR whose 'heart was PROUD of its height... set its top among the clouds', envied by all the trees of Eden, brought down to Sheol (self-exaltation felled); the lament 'you consider yourself a LION of the nations, but you are like a dragon'; 'the PRIDE of Egypt' brought to ruin
